sections.label: Best of the Day
sections.slate: Wednesday this tab went 1-0 (Nuggets). Today: Covers and WagerTalk both back Phoenix at home against a short-handed Charlotte.

straight.reasoning: Two sources agree on Phoenix. Charlotte is without Brandon Miller and Kon Knueppel, and its 124-point game against Cleveland came from 23-of-46 three-point shooting, which is unlikely to repeat on the road. Before that game the Hornets averaged 96.3 points. The line has dropped from -7.5 to -6.5, a better number on the Suns. WagerTalk projects 112-100. Playable to -7.

sections.label: College Hoops
sections.slate: Thursday college basketball. Both picks come from one source each, so they're quarter units.

straight.reasoning: VSiN's Adam Burke: Indiana is in a letdown spot between a win over Syracuse and big games against Arkansas and Kentucky, and should empty its bench early. Tennessee Tech's offense has been efficient under its new coach. Playable to +24.
RotoWire: the Aggies are 24th in KenPom and 17th in adjusted offense, play at the nation's fastest pace, and are at home. Price is an estimate; playable to -8.

sections.label: Football
sections.slate: Thursday Night Football: Commanders @ Giants, 5:15 PM PT on Prime Video. Giants -2 to -2.5, total 41 to 41.5 (opened 43-44.5). Rain expected.

straight.reasoning: TheSpread, DraftKings Network and Sportsbook Review all take the Giants; Covers takes Washington, so this isn't unanimous. The Giants' pass rush had seven sacks against Philadelphia, Jayden Daniels has been sacked 4+ times in three of his last four games, and Washington is 0-3 on the road and without center Lucas Patrick. Take -2 if your book has it. Playable to -2.5; skip at -3.
